_note: Seasonal themes mixed into the normal rotation. Each month lists themes in the same format as themes.json. Optional per theme: "days": [first,last] limits it to those days of the month; "pin": true makes it take every post in its days. Dates of awareness months and days change, so check them each year. Keep wording factual: no results guarantees or claims.

settings._rotation_note: rotation "posts" moves the themes on one step per draft day listed in post_days, so each post gets the next theme. Keep post_days the same as the Worker's draft days (DRAFT_DAYS, default sun,thu). "daily" moves on every calendar day, "weekly" once a week.
